eslint/no-restricted-globals.name: Date
eslint/no-restricted-globals.message: Date is banned: use Temporal (bun >= 1.4 ships it; mise.toml pins bun "1.4"; `mise run doctor` bun-floor guards the runtime).

eslint-js/no-restricted-syntax.message: switch is banned: ts-pattern's match(..).exhaustive() where the file may import it, else an if/else chain or a lookup table.
nested ternaries are banned: one level max; beyond that ts-pattern's match(), an if/else chain, or early returns.

try is banned (catch AND finally): errors as values — neverthrow's fromThrowable/fromAsyncThrowable where the file may import it, else agents/hooks/attempt.ts (Promise.try, zero-dep), or Promise.try(fn).then(ok, err) inline in a self-contained skill; cleanup via using / await using / DisposableStack, or promise.finally().

a listener on process.stdin keeps the process alive after it has its answer: reclaim-purge printed '✅ purge 完了' and then hung (2026-10-06). Read one line with prompt() (null on EOF), all of stdin with Bun.stdin.text() (hooks: readStdinJson).
hand-written `x is T` guard is banned (writing-typescript): parse the value with a zod schema (safeParse) and use the parsed output; a guard drifts from the type it guards.
probing with `"key" in value` is banned (writing-typescript): parse the value with a zod schema (safeParse); for your own union use a discriminant tag.
`as` cast is banned (writing-typescript): it asserts a type the compiler cannot verify. Parse with a zod schema, or use `satisfies` / inference. (`as const` is allowed.)
`<T>value` cast is banned (writing-typescript): parse with a zod schema, or use `satisfies` / inference.

JSON.parse is banned (zod first). Decode JSON text with zod in one step: `jsonOf(Schema).safeParse(text)` — import { jsonOf, z } from agents/hooks/zod.ts (relative path). It returns the typed value, or a zod error that covers both bad JSON (code invalid_format) and the wrong shape: no try, no `unknown` round-trip, no annotation. For the raw JSON value use `jsonText` from the same module.
`.json()` returns `any` (zod first): read `.text()` and decode it with `jsonOf(Schema).safeParse(text)` from agents/hooks/zod.ts, so the body is validated where it enters.

paths.name: zod
paths.message: Import `z` (and `jsonOf` for JSON text) from agents/hooks/zod.ts (relative path), the repo's one zod: hooks run before `bun install`, so zod ships as a generated bundle and every file uses that same copy.

patterns.message: Import `z` from agents/hooks/zod.ts (relative path), the repo's one zod.
